title: circles.yaml — the person's configuration (spec_version 0)
description: The machine half of circles-yaml.md (RULES rule 7): the config file's shape. Open where the page rules unknown keys a build warning (top level, items — ⚖-R7), closed inside status: (an unknown adapter is a config error). Cross-field and filesystem checks (unique ids, yellow_after < red_after, source containment, argv[0] exists and is executable, a known IANA zone) are not expressible here and stay in bake/config.py, which also owns the exact config-error messages (⚖-R52).

spec_version.description: Optional; absent means 0. A version newer than the bake understands is a config error.

timezone.description: IANA zone name anchoring freshness math (⚖-R18); default UTC.

slug.description: Ring and item ids; the slash is excluded because it is the <ring>/<item> ref separator.

label.description: Opaque Unicode text; glyphs pass through untouched.

items.description: Required key; may be empty — an empty band plus a build warning (⚖-R13).

link.description: An absolute http(s) URL or a root-relative path; javascript:, data:, //… and bare relative paths are config errors (⚖-R16).

share.description: Relative arc weight within the ring, > 0, default 1.

status.description: Exactly one adapter key from the closed v0 set; absent status means unmonitored. Unknown keys inside status: are config errors (⚖-R7).

manual.description: A hand-set light; grey is not a manual value (omit status: instead).

command.description: An argv array, never a shell string; ≥1 element.

source.description: Path or glob relative to the config directory; absolute paths and leading parent traversal are rejected (full containment is checked by bake/config.py).

yellow_after.description: Whole days, ≥ 1, strictly less than red_after (the cross-field half is config.py's).
